mainEntity.name: What should I check before letting a launch bot touch my sales pages or checkout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Give the launch workflow a complete setup brief and keep it in review mode until every customer-facing element has been checked. Include the platform, product, price, checkout, delivery, refund or support process, pages, email sequence, tracking, and approval owner. Ask the bot to produce a checklist and drafts rather than assuming it can configure accounts by itself. Test the purchase path with a controlled transaction, confirm delivery and notifications, and verify that links and analytics work. Recheck the offer language across checkout, thank-you, upsell, downsell, and email materials. Run My AI Biz describes launch assistance as a repeatable setup aid with review before anything goes live.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep the launch workflow in draft mode and provide a complete setup brief covering platform, offer, price, delivery, support, pages, emails, tracking, and approvals. Use a launch checklist, test the purchase and delivery path, verify links and analytics, and review every customer-facing claim before publishing.
